verdict.rationale: Bruno explicitly avoids cloud sync/accounts, instead enabling team collaboration by storing collections as plain text files that teams share via Git (init, diff, pull, commit built-in). Community reports confirm this works well for git-based collaboration, but it is not a synced shared workspace in the real-time/cloud sense the story implies. Missing for 10: cloud-hosted synced workspace, real-time multi-user sync, account-based team spaces.
